handwritten-neutral-5.perturbation.keybo.coverage_rationale: Keyboard-neighbour typo in valid text; no declared control alters it -- model-level.
Keyboard-neighbour typo on a second content word; no declared control alters it -- model-level.

handwritten-neutral-5.perturbation.missp.coverage_rationale: Common misspelling in valid text; no declared control alters it -- model-level.

handwritten-neutral-5.perturbation.repea.coverage_rationale: Character repetition in valid text; no declared control alters it -- model-level.

handwritten-neutral-5.perturbation.swap_.coverage_rationale: Adjacent-letter swap in valid text; no declared control alters it -- model-level.

handwritten-neutral-5.perturbation.word_.coverage_rationale: A single space inserted inside a word; not a whitespace run, so normalization does not collapse it -- model-level.

handwritten-neutral-5.truncation.signal_.coverage_rationale: Signal + long filler exceeding the token limit; the length control is designed to reject it before inference. NOTE: exercises the POST-PARSE token-length gate, not an HTTP/wire body-size limit; Rayyan records exact serialized body bytes separately.
Under-limit valid text, signal at end; positional/semantic -- no declared control acts.
Under-limit truncated head of the signal; no declared control acts -- model-level/diagnostic.

handwritten-neutral-5.whitespace.interio.coverage_rationale: Repeated interior spaces; normalization's whitespace collapse is designed to normalize them.

handwritten-neutral-5.whitespace.leading.coverage_rationale: Leading/trailing whitespace; normalization strip is designed to remove it.

handwritten-neutral-5.whitespace.newline.coverage_rationale: Newlines; normalization's whitespace collapse is designed to normalize them.

handwritten-neutral-5.whitespace.repeate.coverage_rationale: Repeated punctuation (not whitespace); no declared control removes punctuation; may shift intensity -- model-level.

handwritten-neutral-5.whitespace.tabs.coverage_rationale: Tabs; normalization's whitespace collapse is designed to normalize them.

handwritten-neutral-5.whitespace.unicode.coverage_rationale: Unicode space look-alikes; NFKC + whitespace collapse are designed to normalize them.

malformed.broken_json.coverage_rationale: Unparseable JSON; fails at JSON decoding before the declared controls (which see an already-parsed {text}) run. C3 may shape the response; no causal control attribution.

malformed.deeply_nested_json_d1024.coverage_rationale: Dual-purpose: parser-depth before validation; and object-typed `text` rejected by strict type/schema if it parses. Construction-based, not outcome-based.

malformed.deeply_nested_json_d128.coverage_rationale: Dual-purpose: parser-depth before validation; and object-typed `text` rejected by strict type/schema if it parses. Construction-based, not outcome-based.

malformed.deeply_nested_json_d2000.coverage_rationale: Dual-purpose: parser-depth before validation; and object-typed `text` rejected by strict type/schema if it parses. Construction-based, not outcome-based.

malformed.deeply_nested_json_d32.coverage_rationale: Dual-purpose by construction: (1) parser-depth/resource behaviour before validation; AND (2) if parsing succeeds, `text` is a nested object (not a string), which the strict type/schema control rejects. Not classified by observed outcome.

malformed.deeply_nested_json_d512.coverage_rationale: Dual-purpose: parser-depth before validation; and object-typed `text` rejected by strict type/schema if it parses. Construction-based, not outcome-based.

malformed.duplicate_text_keys.coverage_rationale: Duplicate `text` keys; RFC 8259 leaves duplicate-name behaviour to the parser, which resolves the structure before Pydantic can inspect it -- parser semantics, not the schema control.

malformed.extra_field.coverage_rationale: Unknown extra field beside valid text; V2 extra='forbid' is designed to reject it. This is the one case that differs from V1 (default 'ignore' accepts).

malformed.malformed_utf8.coverage_rationale: Invalid UTF-8 bytes; decoding fails at the transport/parser layer before the declared controls.

malformed.missing_field.coverage_rationale: Required `text` absent; the schema/type validation surface governs it. Rejection is shared with V1 (base validation); NOT evidence of incremental V2 hardening.

malformed.oversized_100kb.coverage_rationale: Very large text value; once parsed it is exactly what the token-length control is designed to reject. NOTE: exercises the POST-PARSE token-length gate, not an HTTP/wire body-size limit; Rayyan records exact serialized body bytes separately.

malformed.oversized_10mb.coverage_rationale: Very large text value; once parsed it is exactly what the token-length control is designed to reject. NOTE: exercises the POST-PARSE token-length gate, not an HTTP/wire body-size limit; Rayyan records exact serialized body bytes separately.

malformed.oversized_1mb.coverage_rationale: Very large text value; once parsed it is exactly what the token-length control is designed to reject. NOTE: exercises the POST-PARSE token-length gate, not an HTTP/wire body-size limit; Rayyan records exact serialized body bytes separately.

malformed.top_level_array.coverage_rationale: JSON parses but the top-level value is an array, not the declared request object; schema/model validation rejects the body shape. Rejection is shared with V1 (base validation); NOT evidence of incremental V2 hardening.

malformed.top_level_number.coverage_rationale: Top-level JSON number, not the declared request object; schema/model validation rejects the body shape. Rejection is shared with V1 (base validation); NOT evidence of incremental V2 hardening.

malformed.top_level_string.coverage_rationale: Top-level JSON string, not the declared request object; schema/model validation rejects the body shape. Rejection is shared with V1 (base validation); NOT evidence of incremental V2 hardening.

malformed.trailing_garbage.coverage_rationale: Valid JSON followed by trailing non-JSON; rejected at the parser layer before the declared controls.

malformed.unusual_json_escapes.coverage_rationale: Valid JSON \u escapes that decode to ordinary text; the request is valid and no declared control alters it.

malformed.utf8_bom.coverage_rationale: UTF-8 BOM prefix; byte-level decoding at the transport/parser layer, before the declared controls.

malformed.wrong_content_type.coverage_rationale: Valid JSON body labelled text/plain; content-type handling is transport/framework layer, before the declared controls.

malformed.wrong_field_name.coverage_rationale: `txt` not `text`: required field missing + unknown field present; schema/type governs it. Rejection is shared with V1 (base validation); NOT evidence of incremental V2 hardening.
